summary: Implemented AgentCore ecosystem activation planning as a frozen PlanSpec and wired aom activate to return a read-only activation plan preview instead of direct activation.
acceptance_evidence: ActivationPlanningRequest validates staged artifact evidence, replay evidence, compatibility evidence, lock hash, registry snapshot digest, previous active set hash, policy version and rollback handle.
EcosystemActivationPlanner emits a 3-step PlanSpec: ecosystem.replay.verify, ecosystem.compatibility.check and ecosystem.activate.
ActivationPlanPreview reports approval_required=true, rollback_required=true, security_execution_required=true, planner_can_execute_directly=false and active_mutated=false.
Missing replay or compatibility evidence is rejected before PlanSpec output.
Planning does not create active artifact state.
Policy-pack activation is inferred as policy_broadening and pauses with awaiting-policy-broadening-approval.
aom activate now stages local artifacts inertly and returns plan_spec plus activation_plan_preview with active=false and activation_prepared=false.

commands.summary: 2 aom tests passed, including activate PlanSpec preview output.
agent_core 107, agentd 58, runtime_contracts 23 and security_execution 79 tests passed, plus doc tests.

blocked_shortcuts: AgentCore planner cannot directly activate artifacts.
Missing replay or compatibility evidence is a hard error.
Activation planning does not mutate active state.
Policy-broadening activation cannot bypass explicit approval.
promotion_impact: Completes the AgentCore side of runtime-mediated ecosystem activation and gives operators a reviewable activation PlanSpec before any side effect can be prepared.
